description: Climate-stripes ribbon: one stripe per year, colored by era heat level on a sequential ramp.

meta.question: When was this field hot, and when was it cold?
meta.whenToUse: Long multi-decade timelines where the story is alternating hot/cold eras, not exact values.
meta.antiUse: Short ranges or continuous quantitative series — use a line or bar chart when exact magnitudes matter.
